Coleman and T C Jones, we have a very strong team, while the team race may be made the medium for a trial to select the "Jockey Cup" team. On the 18th our Juniors are at Harrow, where they are meeting the Old Gaytonians in an Inter-Club match The fixture has been arranged with the help of Mr.

George's Services S.C., we participated (with Mitcham A.C.) in two events, a junior (under 19) relay, 6 x 880yds., and a two miles team race, which served as a trial to select the team to defend the "Jockey" Cup on the following Saturday. Our junior relay team ran in the following order : T.

Purdy was successful in the "100" in a close finish, and another very close finish in the half-mile gave Tom Pritchard a win from A. Chubb and T.
The Mile Handicap was won by Tom Pritchard off 180 yds. in fast time, and Norman Dewberry (148) was third. T.
Rollins won this race in 1927 and 1928, and no doubt would have won it last year but for ill-health. However, he regained his "title" this year, being pushed home by Coleman and T.
Cook the only back-marker to qualify for the final. This was a well-contested race and T.
The remaining handicap was the hurdles race. This was won by Harper, who just beat the back-marker, T.
